limitations: Curated 20 km square only, not the complete 87-90 degree south polar cap.
5 degree horizon bins and 80/320 m radial sampling can miss narrow blockers; comparative prototype only.
Terrain beyond 200 km and subpixel obstacles are not modeled.
Slope and roughness use published 100 m baseline products sampled on a 1 km output grid; not a landing hazard assessment.
DEM quality/error/count masks are not included; absence of these masks prevents confidence claims.
PSR proximity uses mapped 20 m pixel areas in the polar projection; its local scale distortion is below 0.01 percent in the buffered crop.
Mapped PSRs are not date-specific shadow predictions or evidence of accessible water ice.
Feature proximity uses published IAU center coordinates, not geological feature boundaries.

psr.distance_definition: Projected distance to the union of mapped 20 m PSR pixel areas; zero inside.
